title: Asset Management Analyst, Origination
description:
About Cipher Mining

We are an industrial-scale data center construction and operations company. We allocate data center opportunities between bitcoin mining and other high performance computing services, such as AI. We continue to develop our pipeline of power capacity at high quality data center sites, either for bitcoin mining or HPC. Our best-in-class management team leverages expertise from the technology, fintech, energy, and finance domains, as well as deep experience related to cryptocurrencies and blockchain.

The Asset Management Analyst, Origination supports the front end of Cipher’s asset lifecycle — land and parcel diligence, entitlements, and technical and environmental feasibility. The role maintains front-end pipeline visibility and supports site selection and acquisition decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Support parcel diligence and option / lease-to-own evaluation.
  • Coordinate technical and environmental studies as part of site feasibility.
  • Support front-end origination alongside Business Development and Legal, providing operational context for due diligence and feasibility.
  • Track entitlements and permitting across the portfolio and pipeline.
  • Monitor diligence timelines and flag risks to critical-path items (studies, approvals, permits).
  • Maintain organized diligence records, checklists, and per-site data repositories.
  • Flag power and interconnection considerations and communicate action items to responsible teams.
  • Package diligence findings into a site summary for review and origination decisions.
  • Support handoff from origination into development as a site advances.

Qualifications

Required

  • 2–4 years in in real estate development, infrastructure, energy, or transactional diligence.
  • Hands-on diligence experience — title, survey, zoning, environmental, or entitlement review.
  • Comfort coordinating third-party studies and consultants for the land and entitlement processes and technical and environmental studies.
  • Able to track timelines across multiple sites and flag critical-path risks proactively.
  • Clear written communication — can package diligence findings into a concise site summary for decision-makers.

Preferred

  • Data center development exposure specifically.
  • Experience across a multi-site portfolio or pipeline, rather than a single-asset.

Scope/Boundaries

  • Owns: front-end diligence execution and feasibility coordination — parcel and site diligence, technical and environmental studies, entitlements and permitting tracking, diligence records and per-site repositories, and the site-summary packaging that moves a site toward development-readiness.
  • Partners with:Business Development, Legal and land consultants.
  • Does not own:deal negotiations, financial models or underwriting, power and interconnection (flags and routes, does not own).

Benefits*

  • 401K Retirement Plan with match
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • And other perks!

*Full Time Employees

title: Lead Electrical Engineer
description:
About Cipher Mining

We are an industrial-scale data center construction and operations company. We allocate data center opportunities between bitcoin mining and other high performance computing services, such as AI. We continue to develop our pipeline of power capacity at high quality data center sites, either for bitcoin mining or HPC. Our best-in-class management team leverages expertise from the technology, fintech, energy, and finance domains, as well as deep experience related to cryptocurrencies and blockchain.

Summary

We are seeking a Lead Electrical Engineer to lead and coordinate all electrical design disciplines and decisions across a portfolio of fast-track hyperscale data center projects.

This role is deeply embedded in project execution, responsible for reviewing detailed electrical designs, resolving complex technical issues, coordinating with contractors and utilities, and participating directly in project, vendor, and customer discussions.

Given the mission-critical nature of electrical systems in data centers, the ideal candidate has significant experience in both the design and operation of data centers, with a strong understanding of how design decisions impact construction, commissioning, reliability, and long-term operations.

Core Responsibilities

Electrical Design Leadership & Coordination

  • Lead all electrical engineering efforts across projects, including:
    • Utility interconnections and substations
    • Medium- and low-voltage power distribution
    • Transformers, switchgear, and protection schemes
    • Backup power systems (generators, UPS where applicable)
    • Grounding, bonding, and life safety interfaces
  • Coordinate electrical design across:
    • Concept
    • Schematic
    • Detailed design phases
  • Ensure alignment between electrical, mechanical, CSA, and technology systems

Drawing Review & Technical Oversight

  • Perform detailed reviews of:
    • Electrical drawings, specifications, and calculations
    • One-lines, load studies, and protection coordination
  • Identify and resolve:
    • Design gaps
    • Constructability issues
    • Interface risks
  • Ensure designs reflect:
    • Operational realities
    • Commissioning and maintenance needs

Contractor, Utility & Vendor Engagement

  • Participate in:
    • Design coordination meetings
    • Contractor constructability reviews
    • Utility and AHJ discussions
    • Vendor technical reviews
  • Support field teams by:
    • Responding to RFIs
    • Reviewing submittals
    • Supporting energization and commissioning efforts
  • Serve as a trusted technical interface with:
    • Utilities
    • Electrical contractors
    • OEMs

External Consultant & EOR Management

  • Manage electrical Engineers of Record and specialty consultants
  • Review and approve deliverables for quality, completeness, and alignment with standards
  • Ensure external teams meet schedule and performance expectations

Standards, Reliability & Continuous Improvement

  • Support development and refinement of:
    • Electrical design standards
    • Reference architectures
    • Redundancy and reliability philosophies
  • Incorporate lessons learned from:
    • Construction
    • Commissioning
    • Operations
  • Balance standardization with site-specific and utility-driven requirements

What Success Looks Like

  • Electrical designs are robust, buildable, and scalable
  • Fewer electrical RFIs, changes, and field conflicts
  • Smooth utility coordination and energization
  • Commissioning proceeds without major rework
  • Electrical standards improve delivery speed and reliability

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 12–18+ years of experience in:
    • Electrical engineering
    • Mission-critical or industrial power systems
  • Significant experience with:
    • Data center design and operations
    • High-density power environments
  • Proven ability to review and coordinate:
    • Complex electrical systems and drawings
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Power distribution
    • Protection and controls
    • Codes and standards (NEC, IEEE, etc.)
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced, lean environments

Strongly Preferred / Differentiators

  • Professional Engineering (PE) license (strongly preferred)
  • Direct experience with:
    • HPC, AI/ML, or crypto data centers
  • Experience supporting:
    • Utility interconnections and substations
  • Exposure to:
    • Commissioning and operational turnover
  • Comfort interfacing directly with utilities, contractors, and customers

Benefits*

  • 401K Retirement Plan with match
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • And other perks!

title: Senior Design Manager
description:
About Cipher Mining

We are an industrial-scale data center construction and operations company. We allocate data center opportunities between bitcoin mining and other high performance computing services, such as AI. We continue to develop our pipeline of power capacity at high quality data center sites, either for bitcoin mining or HPC. Our best-in-class management team leverages expertise from the technology, fintech, energy, and finance domains, as well as deep experience related to cryptocurrencies and blockchain.

Summary

The Design Manager for Hyperscale Data Center Programs will lead the coordination, integration, and execution of design efforts across a portfolio of fast-track hyperscale data center projects. This role ensures that architecture, engineering disciplines, and procurement are aligned to deliver design outputs on time, within program schedules and budgets. The Design Project Manager will collaborate closely with engineering discipline managers, external engineers of record (EORs), and the procurement team to manage design workflows, reviews, and procurement decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate design efforts across Civil/Structural/Architectural (CSA), Electrical, Mechanical, and specialty systems.
  • Ensure integration between architecture, engineering disciplines, design, construction sequencing, and procurement timelines.
  • Serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering and PMO for design execution.
  • Develop and manage design schedules and milestones aligned with program timelines.
  • Track design deliverables across all disciplines and external consultants.
  • Identify and escalate design risks impacting construction start, long-lead procurement, and commissioning milestones.
  • Coordinate drawing production and multidisciplinary drawing review sessions.
  • Organize and facilitate design coordination meetings and drawing review workshops.
  • Coordinate design-related RFIs from construction teams and ensure timely responses.
  • Work closely with the procurement team to align design decisions with supplier capabilities and lead times.
  • Provide regular design status updates to the Director of Engineering and Director of Program Management.

Required Skills

  • 8–15+ years of experience in design project management, engineering coordination, or architecture/engineering project delivery.
  • Strong experience coordinating multi-discipline design teams and external EORs and consultants.
  • Solid understanding of construction workflows and procurement impacts on design.
  • Experience operating in fast-track or design-build environments.
  • Strong organizational and facilitation skills.

Benefits*

  • 401K Retirement Plan with match
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • And other perks!

About the Role

Cipher Digital is hiring a Business Analyst to support our IT organization as we continue to roll out and mature enterprise platforms, including ServiceNow. This role is a generalist business analyst position — the core skill set is requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder facilitation. Exposure to ServiceNow is a plus, but deep platform expertise is not required.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather and clarify requirements
  • Document, and write clear user stories/requirements for the development team
  • Align stakeholders on process design before build
  • Facilitate workshops and demos to build stakeholder consensus
  • Support UAT, training, and adoption for new rollouts
  • Act as a liaison between business teams and technical/implementation teams

Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of solid business analysis experience across any platform or domain
  • Strong requirements-gathering and process-mapping skills
  • Experience translating business needs into functional specs or user stories
  • Strong facilitation skills — comfortable running workshops with non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong coordination skills — able to manage multiple stakeholders, timelines, and moving pieces at once
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Exposure to ServiceNow or similar enterprise platforms a plus
  • Background in change management or user adoption/training a plus

Location: Denver Metro Area.
